summary: OpenAI is rolling out a Health feature in ChatGPT for U.S. users that lets them connect Apple Health data and supported medical records so the model can ground health-related conversations in personal medical context.

practices.reason: The health-tuned models show measurable gains in escalation judgment and reasoning over complex medical details, but the evaluation is the lab's own unreplicated HealthBench and narrow to a domain most teams don't build on.
practices.quote: GPT‑5.5 Instant, available to users on the Free plan, has made meaningful gains in recognizing when urgent care may be needed, asking for relevant context, explaining uncertainty, and making complex information easier to understand.

practices.reason: The physician-built rubric methodology for scoring accuracy, safety, communication, context awareness, completeness and escalation is a transferable idea for evaluating high-stakes model responses, even though the instrument itself (HealthBench Professional) is the lab's own.
practices.quote: we work with hundreds of physicians around the world to develop realistic health scenarios and detailed rubrics that define what a strong response should do. These evaluations assess qualities including accuracy, safety, communication, context awareness, completeness, and appropriate escalation.
